fields.quote: Sezonul se va încheia, odată cu a zecea etapă de play-off, în weekendul 29-30 mai 2027.
fields.note: Season end is announced as a weekend (play-off round 10, 29-30 May 2027), not a single day, so no MM-DD is recorded. Wikipedia gives only the month: ro infobox '17 iulie 2026 - mai 2027', en infobox '18 July 2026 – May 2027'. LPF's own fixture list confirms the regular season ends on 13 March 2027 (etapa 30, all matches Saturday) but the play-off calendar is drawn after the split. No proxy used: the target season's own announced range (29-30 May) contradicts the previous season's last day (25 May 2026), so a proxy would be less accurate than the note itself.

Record inherited from RO1 in the asset. No day for 2026-27: ro infobox '1 august 2026 - mai 2027'; en 2026–27 Liga II infobox '1 August 2026 – May 2027'. Value is the previous season's last day (16 May 2026) used as a proxy. Liga II (22 clubs, 21-round regular season plus play-off/play-out groups) has no published 2026-27 end date.
